ValidationRule.description: If Pre-screening Result = Accept then Salary is transferred to ila is mandatory.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Credit_Pre_Screening_Result__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Pre_Screening_Result__c, "Accept"), ISPICKVAL(cc_Approved_Requested_Card_Type__c, "PLATINUM_BALANCE_TRANSFER_01"), IF(cc_Salary_is_Transferred_to_ila__c == false , true, false), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), ISPICKVAL( Type , "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the Salary is Transferred to ila field.
